remarks: Located in the sought-after Fountain Terrace, this bright, spacious, and impeccably updated 1-bedroom apartment is nestled in the vibrant heart of downtown Stamford. Featuring a sleek, modern kitchen with stainless steel appliances and a gas stove, a chic, newly renovated bathroom, and a generous balcony with sunny southern views off the living room. The complex boasts one of Fairfield County's largest in-ground pools, a well-equipped fitness center, and is both pet-friendly and convenient with on-site laundry. This secure building includes heat, hot water, and an assigned parking space in the HOA fee. Just steps away from Stamford's lively nightlife, restaurants, shopping, and bars, and perfectly positioned near Metro-North, I-95, and bus lines for easy commuting. Don't miss the opportunity to make this your home-schedule a viewing today before it's gone!
